treasure1.name: Token
treasure1.image_alt: A single stamped brass token resting on a folded coral cloth.

treasure2.name: Reserve
treasure2.image_alt: A metal strongbox holding several neatly stacked brass coins.

treasure3.name: Endowment
treasure3.image_alt: An open endowment chest overflowing with coins, jewels and a ribboned deed.

victory1.name: Plot
victory1.description: Worth 1 point at the end of the game.
victory1.image_alt: A small planted garden plot with a gate, young tree and tidy vegetable rows.

victory2.name: Quarter
victory2.description: Worth 3 points at the end of the game.
victory2.image_alt: A cozy neighborhood square with three colorful houses and a fountain.

victory3.name: City
victory3.description: Worth 6 points at the end of the game.
victory3.image_alt: A sunlit city skyline of towers, terracotta roofs and an arched bridge.

curse.name: Burden
curse.description: Worth minus 1 point at the end of the game.
curse.image_alt: A heavy cracked stone tied with rope, crushing a small fallen leaf.

k01.name: Craftsperson
k01.description: Take a card costing up to 5 into your hand. Then put a card from your hand on top of your deck.
k01.image_alt: A carpenter’s plane, wooden shavings and a teal vase on a workbench.

k02.name: Raider
k02.description: Take an Endowment. Each opponent reveals their top 2 cards, scraps a revealed Treasure other than Token if possible, and discards the rest.
k02.image_alt: A red-sailed raiding boat carrying a brass chest across blue water.

k03.name: Administrator
k03.description: Take a Reserve onto your deck. Each opponent puts a Victory card from their hand onto their deck, or reveals a hand without any.
k03.image_alt: A wax-sealed document beside a brass stamp and a neat stack of folders.

k04.name: Storeroom
k04.description: Gain 1 action. Discard as many cards as you choose, then draw that many cards.
k04.image_alt: A pantry shelf of jars, folded sacks and a wooden produce crate.

k05.name: Sanctuary
k05.description: Scrap up to 4 cards from your hand.
k05.image_alt: A candle glowing beneath a stone arch in a peaceful flower garden.

k06.name: Assembly
k06.description: Draw 4 cards and gain 1 buy. Every other player draws 1 card.
k06.image_alt: Six chairs gathered around a round meeting table with shared papers.

k07.name: Celebration
k07.image_alt: Colorful festival bunting above a drum, lanterns and ribbons.

k08.name: Greenbelt
k08.description: Worth 1 point for every complete group of 10 cards in your deck, counting all zones, at game end.
k08.image_alt: A winding path and small footbridge through a flowering green park.

k09.name: Courier
k09.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. You may put a card from your discard pile onto your deck.
k09.image_alt: A coral courier bicycle with a basket of envelopes beside a signpost.

k10.name: Research House
k10.image_alt: A sunlit glass research house with a blue flask and growing seedlings.

k11.name: Archive
k11.description: Draw until your hand contains 7 cards. You may set aside Action cards drawn this way; discard them after drawing finishes.
k11.image_alt: Tall wooden archive shelves, a rolling ladder and an open book.

k12.name: Exchange
k12.description: Draw 1 card; gain 1 action, 1 buy and 1 coin.
k12.image_alt: Three bright market awnings sheltering fruit and pottery stalls.

k13.name: Broker
k13.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. The first Reserve you play this turn provides 1 extra coin.
k13.image_alt: A brass trading scale balancing coins and a cloth pouch beside a ledger.

k14.name: Patrol
k14.description: Gain 2 coins. Every opponent discards until they have 3 cards in hand.
k14.image_alt: A watch lantern and striped patrol shield resting beside a gate.

k15.name: Refinery
k15.description: You may scrap a Treasure from your hand, then take a Treasure costing at most 3 more into your hand.
k15.image_alt: Copper refining vessels and curled pipes above glowing furnace coals.

k16.name: Breakwater
k16.description: Draw 2 cards. When an opponent attacks, you may reveal this from your hand to avoid that attack.
k16.image_alt: A stone breakwater and red lighthouse protecting calm water from waves.

k17.name: Financier
k17.description: You may scrap a Token from your hand to gain 3 coins.
k17.image_alt: An abacus, brass coins and an open accounts book on a desk.

k18.name: Forager
k18.description: Draw 1 card, gain 1 action and 1 coin. Discard 1 card for each empty supply pile.
k18.image_alt: A woven basket of mushrooms, berries and leafy forest finds.

k19.name: Renovator
k19.description: Scrap a card from your hand. Take a card costing at most 2 more into your discard pile.
k19.image_alt: A half-restored cottage with scaffolding, a ladder and fresh terracotta roof tiles.

k20.name: Lookout
k20.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. Inspect the top 2 cards of your deck. Scrap any, discard any, then return the rest in your chosen order.
k20.image_alt: A tall coastal lookout tower with a telescope facing the horizon.

k21.name: Forge
k21.image_alt: A glowing forge furnace, iron anvil and hammer with flying sparks.

k22.name: Chamber
k22.description: You may choose an Action from your hand and play it twice.
k22.image_alt: Two matching high-backed seats facing one another beneath a patterned canopy.

k23.name: Deputy
k23.description: Gain 2 coins. Discard your top card; if it is an Action, you may play it.
k23.image_alt: A deputy’s brass badge, folded map and walking staff beside a satchel.

k24.name: Crossroads
k24.image_alt: A forked country path meeting at a three-way wooden signpost.

k25.name: Hexer
k25.description: Draw 2 cards. Every opponent takes a Burden, if any remain.
k25.image_alt: A violet potion swirling above a copper cauldron, with herbs and a crescent charm.

k26.name: Atelier
k26.description: Take a card costing up to 4 into your discard pile.
k26.image_alt: An artist’s easel, ceramic pitcher and a fan of paintbrushes in a bright studio.
